tools.name: validate
tools.description: Validate a JSON payload against a JSON Schema. Returns a signed attestation proving validation occurred. Deterministic: same inputs always produce the same result.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Verify the cryptographic signature of a validation attestation. Confirm that a previous validation result has not been tampered with.

tools.name: get_attestation
tools.description: Retrieve a stored validation attestation by its ID. Returns the full attestation record including schema hash, payload hash, validation result, and cryptographic signature.
